dataset.name: Online Retail
dataset.attribution: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33
dataset.intended_use: One local, non-commercial retrospective event-time study; not point-in-time validation or SKU demand validation

source_metadata.missingness_discrepancy: The downloaded workbook contains blank cells in excluded CustomerID and Description columns despite the UCI page's no-missing-values statement. These fields are not projected, used for row selection, or emitted. No Description text is retained or included in results.

invoice_number_handling.standard_identifiers: Exact six-digit integer cells or six-digit ASCII digit strings enter the existing projection.
invoice_number_handling.cancellation_identifiers: Only uppercase C followed by six ASCII digits is normalized to the existing cancellation marker and counted as cancelled.
invoice_number_handling.unverified_prefix_identifiers: Lowercase c and every other single ASCII letter followed by six ASCII digits are excluded before aggregation and counted only in one aggregate unverified-prefix category; original identifiers are not retained.
invoice_number_handling.unsupported_formats: All other formats fail closed without echoing the value.

stock_code_contract.integer_cell_normalization: Convert exact positive five-digit integer cells to their decimal string; do not pad or infer from another column.
stock_code_contract.internal_space_handling: Preserve exactly as opaque category keys; no trim, filter, merge, or Description-based interpretation.
stock_code_contract.interpretation: Units per StockCode category; not verified physical SKU demand.

initial_reader_attempts.correction: Replaced with selective Expat OOXML streaming that does not capture or decode Description body values.

processing.stop_reason: The approved 250000 product-day group ceiling was exceeded; the reader failed closed before returning a projection.

attempts.reason: The pre-MM-020 projection exceeded the generic 100000 group cap.
The approved call exceeded its product-day group cap after applying the MM-021 unverified-prefix exclusion.

processing.next_action: MM-024 reconfirms the existing UCI-only classification but does not reduce product-day group cardinality from the stopped MM-021 attempt. Do not chunk, sample, or widen the 250000-group cap; any alternative evaluation design requires a separate owner and model-review decision. No projection, complete exclusion count, or metric is available.

interpretation_limits: InvoiceDate is transaction event time, not first-publication availability.
UCI provides no verified row-level publication vintage for this protocol.
The publisher's stated date coverage is a completeness assertion, not an independently audited retailer ledger.
Excluded field missingness differs from UCI page metadata and remains disclosed.
No empirical score, forecast skill, latent demand, inventory, lead-time, causal, commercial, or point-in-time claim is established.
